digest.component_or_area: FILE_IMPACT event reducer and its CLI/library/MCP surfaces
propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded, conflating 'author forgot' with 'ticket touches no repo file', forcing consumers into a conservative reading.

Adds a third state via file_impact_scope with values undeclared/paths/none plus no_file_impact_reason, derived in a pure helper applied by process_file_impact on every FILE_IMPACT event using last-writer-wins.
Moves set-file-impact from the fixed-arity _REGISTRY to the variadic _ARGV_REGISTRY so a new '--none <reason>' form can be parsed alongside the unchanged JSON-array form.
Exactly one of the array form or --none must be present; supplying both, neither, or --none without a value is a usage error exiting 2 naming both forms.
The --none reason must have at least 10 non-whitespace characters (len of joined split >=10), rejecting whitespace-padded values with a message stating the non-whitespace rule and writing no event.
Exposes the tri-state via library function get_file_impact_scope returning kind/reason/paths, in rebar show, and via a new MCP declare_no_file_impact tool shaped as a string-ack with no outputSchema.
